{{Quote|Well, maybe this blumfruit tart will change your mind.|Latara coaxes Baga with a blumfruit tart|audio=BlumfruitTart-Ewoks.flac|<ref name="Princess Latara" />}}
'''Blumfruit tarts''' were a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] item that consisted of a [[Color/Legends|pink]], [[Blumfruit/Legends|blumfruit]] filling held in a pastry base.<ref name="Princess Latara" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="EwoksDate">{{EwoksDate|appearance of a [[Blumfruit/Legends|blumfruit]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|tart]]|[[Princess Latara]]}}</ref> the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] was riding the stubborn [[Bordok/Legends|bordok]] [[Baga]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], and she [[Diet/Legends|fed]] the [[Species/Legends|creature]] a blumfruit tart to coax it into moving. Baga quickly ate the tart and began to sprint, ejecting Latara from her [[Saddle/Legends|saddle]].<ref name="Princess Latara" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blumfruit tarts appeared in "[[Princess Latara]],"<ref name="Princess Latara" /> the fourth episode in the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Paul Dini]] and premiered on [[September 20]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
